evidence: Carries the IPC label and modifies src/ipc/, src/interfaces/ipc.h, and IPC listener options.
rationale: This PR resolves a denial-of-service and crash risk from unbounded connections and missing file descriptor accounting on IPC listeners. As noted in the description, 'IPC listening sockets lacked connection limits and were omitted from initialization file descriptor reservations, creating a potential denial-of-service or crash risk via file descriptor exhaustion', while also adding flexible per-listener connection configuration.
